nodes.name: org2CloudBackendAdapter.ts
nodes.summary: Adapts Org2Cloud remote sessions into the generic CollabSyncBackend interface used by the team-collaboration sync engine, translating cloud session row ids and building a fetch-based sync client.

nodes.name: buildCloudSessionFetchClient
nodes.summary: Builds a CollabSyncBackend-compatible client that fetches and decodes segment/tail wire data for a cloud session over HTTP using the given access token.

nodes.name: org2CloudClient.ts
nodes.summary: Core Supabase-backed RPC client for Org2Cloud: authenticates requests, fetches the caller's profile, lists orgs/members, checks entitlements, and refreshes auth sessions.

nodes.name: rpcHeaders
nodes.summary: Builds the standard authorization and API-key headers for an Org2Cloud RPC request.

nodes.name: callRpc
nodes.summary: Performs a POST call to an Org2Cloud Supabase RPC endpoint and parses the JSON response, throwing on non-OK status.

nodes.name: getCloudProfile
nodes.summary: Fetches the authenticated user's Org2Cloud profile via RPC and validates it against the profile schema.

nodes.name: listMyOrgs
nodes.summary: Lists the cloud organizations the current user belongs to via RPC.

nodes.name: listOrgMembers
nodes.summary: Lists the members of a given cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: getEntitlementState
nodes.summary: Fetches the entitlement/billing state for a cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: refreshSession
nodes.summary: Exchanges a refresh token for a new Org2Cloud auth session against the configured endpoint.

nodes.name: ensureFreshSession
nodes.summary: Ensures the given auth state has a non-expired access token, refreshing it via refreshSession when needed.

nodes.name: org2CloudCommentTasksAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom and pure helpers for tracking in-flight agent comment tasks per org/session, merging incremental updates and looking up tasks by session or comment id.

nodes.name: isNewerTaskUpdate
nodes.summary: Determines whether a candidate comment-task update is newer than the currently stored baseline.

nodes.name: mergeCommentTasks
nodes.summary: Merges an incoming batch of comment tasks into the existing task map, keeping only newer updates.

nodes.name: tasksForSession
nodes.summary: Filters the comment-task map down to the tasks belonging to a specific org/session pair.

nodes.name: taskForComment
nodes.summary: Looks up the comment task associated with a given comment id.

nodes.name: org2CloudCommentTasksClient.ts
nodes.summary: RPC client for the Org2Cloud comment-task queue: creates, claims, leases, heartbeats, completes and releases agent-address tasks tied to session comments.

nodes.name: callTaskRpc
nodes.summary: Performs a POST call to a comment-task RPC endpoint and normalizes error responses into Org2CloudTaskError.

nodes.name: createCommentTask
nodes.summary: Creates a new comment-address task via RPC.

nodes.name: claimCommentTask
nodes.summary: Claims an unowned comment task with a lease so an agent can start working on it.

nodes.name: startCommentTask
nodes.summary: Marks a claimed comment task as started, optionally attaching a fork session id.

nodes.name: heartbeatCommentTask
nodes.summary: Renews the lease on an in-progress comment task and reports progress.

nodes.name: completeCommentTask
nodes.summary: Marks a comment task as completed via RPC.

nodes.name: releaseCommentTask
nodes.summary: Releases a held lease on a comment task, returning it to the queue.

nodes.name: listCommentTasks
nodes.summary: Lists comment tasks for an org, optionally filtered since a given timestamp.

nodes.name: Org2CloudTaskError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown by comment-task RPC calls, carrying a stable error code and HTTP status.

nodes.name: org2CloudCommentsBus.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight in-process/peer event bus that signals when session or org comment threads change, used to trigger local refetches and broadcast changes to collaborators.

nodes.name: bumpLocalCommentsSignal
nodes.summary: Increments the local comments-changed signal atom for a session/org so subscribers refetch.

nodes.name: broadcastCommentsChangedToPeers
nodes.summary: Sends a comments-changed notification to connected peers via the registered broadcaster.

nodes.name: org2CloudCommentsClient.ts
nodes.summary: RPC client for Org2Cloud session comments: adds, edits, deletes, resolves and lists comments attached to shared sessions.

nodes.name: callCommentRpc
nodes.summary: Performs a POST call to a comments RPC endpoint and normalizes error responses into Org2CloudCommentError.

nodes.name: addSessionComment
nodes.summary: Adds a new comment to a shared cloud session via RPC.

nodes.name: editSessionComment
nodes.summary: Edits the body of an existing session comment via RPC.

nodes.name: deleteSessionComment
nodes.summary: Deletes a session comment via RPC.

nodes.name: resolveSessionComment
nodes.summary: Marks a session comment thread as resolved or unresolved, with an optional resolution note.

nodes.name: listSessionComments
nodes.summary: Lists all comments for a given cloud session via RPC.

nodes.name: Org2CloudCommentError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown by comment RPC calls, carrying a stable error code and HTTP status.

nodes.name: org2CloudEndpointAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Holds the persisted Org2Cloud endpoint override (self-hosted vs official backend) and resets all cloud-related atoms when the endpoint is switched.

nodes.name: resetCloudStateForEndpointSwitch
nodes.summary: Clears auth, orgs, presence, sync and comment-related atoms in the given Jotai store when the active cloud endpoint changes.

nodes.name: org2CloudManagementClient.ts
nodes.summary: RPC client for Org2Cloud organization management: create/rename/delete orgs, transfer ownership, manage invites, and update or remove members.

nodes.name: callManagementRpc
nodes.summary: Performs a POST call to an org-management RPC endpoint and normalizes error responses into Org2CloudManagementError.

nodes.name: createCloudOrg
nodes.summary: Creates a new cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: renameCloudOrg
nodes.summary: Renames an existing cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: transferCloudOwnership
nodes.summary: Transfers ownership of a cloud organization to another member via RPC.

nodes.name: createCloudInvite
nodes.summary: Creates an invite code for a cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: listCloudInvites
nodes.summary: Lists active invites for a cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: revokeCloudInvite
nodes.summary: Revokes an existing cloud organization invite via RPC.

nodes.name: updateCloudMemberRole
nodes.summary: Updates a member's role within a cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: removeCloudMember
nodes.summary: Removes a member from a cloud organization via RPC.

nodes.name: Org2CloudManagementError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown by org-management RPC calls, carrying a stable error code and HTTP status.

nodes.name: org2CloudMemberNamesAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom and helper that caches and lazily resolves cloud organization member display names for a given org.

nodes.name: ensureCloudMemberNames
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches display names for all members of a cloud organization if not already loaded.

nodes.name: org2CloudOrgManagement.ts
nodes.summary: Pure domain logic for Org2Cloud organization management: role checks, invite/share code generation and deep-link parsing, invite state derivation, and admin-removal safety checks.

nodes.name: isCloudInviteDeepLink
nodes.summary: Checks whether a URL matches the cloud org invite deep-link format.

nodes.name: parseCloudInviteDeepLink
nodes.summary: Extracts the invite code from a cloud org invite deep link.

nodes.name: isCloudShareDeepLink
nodes.summary: Checks whether a URL matches the cloud session share deep-link format.

nodes.name: parseCloudShareDeepLink
nodes.summary: Extracts the share token from a cloud session share deep link.

nodes.name: parseCloudShareInput
nodes.summary: Parses a raw share link or token input into a usable cloud share token.

nodes.name: deriveCloudInviteState
nodes.summary: Derives the current lifecycle state (active/expired/exhausted) of a cloud org invite relative to now.

nodes.name: countOtherActiveAdmins
nodes.summary: Counts the number of active admins in a member list excluding a given user.

nodes.name: wouldRemoveLastAdmin
nodes.summary: Determines whether demoting or removing a target member would leave the org without an admin.

nodes.name: extractOrg2ManagementErrorCode
nodes.summary: Extracts a known Org2Cloud management error code from a raw error message string.
